pipelines.name: Java CI

steps.name: Install headless Chrome's dependencies
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  ca-certificates \
  fonts-freefont-ttf \
  fonts-ipafont-gothic \
  fonts-kacst \
  fonts-liberation \
  fonts-thai-tlwg \
  fonts-wqy-zenhei \
  libasound2t64 \
  libatk-bridge2.0-0t64 \
  libatk1.0-0t64 \
  libc6 \
  libcairo2 \
  libcups2t64 \
  libdbus-1-3 \
  libdrm2 \
  libexpat1 \
  libgbm1 \
  libglib2.0-0t64 \
  libgtk-3-0t64 \
  libnspr4 \
  libnss3 \
  libpango-1.0-0 \
  libvulkan1 \
  libx11-6 \
  libxcb1 \
  libxcomposite1 \
  libxdamage1 \
  libxext6 \
  libxfixes3 \
  libxkbcommon0 \
  libxrandr2 \
  xdg-utils

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'build' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
